fato_historico: 1995: An avalanche hits the Icelandic village of Flateyri, destroying 29 homes and burying 45 people, and killing 20.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to embrace the resilience of the soul, much like the way nature rebuilds after a storm. It is a good time to focus on your emotional foundation and seek comfort in your connections. Consider how you might turn past challenges into layers of strength as you walk through your day with grace and balance.
frase_do_dia: Even after the heaviest snow, the sun will eventually warm the earth once more.
significado_numero: Represents the master builder and the creation of lasting foundations.
conselho: Tend to your home space and nurture those who offer you steady support.
